instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, health check questions, forms) have clear kebab-case `data-testid` attributes.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdown menus, navigation bars, or overlays. Always provide explicit blur and semi-opaque backgrounds.
Replace the current hero video source with high-end corporate office & project management control room footage.
Elevate homepage sections from plain cards to dynamic bento grids and interactive PMO dashboard visualizations.
Ensure dark theme aesthetic is used for key hero sections, footers, and callouts to showcase Navy Blue (#2C3B7B) and Primary Orange (#F47426).
